summary: Gamehaus Holdings (Nasdaq: GMHS), a Shanghai-based mobile game publisher, furnished a 6-K containing a founder/chairman shareholder letter following its November 2, 2026 definitive agreements to acquire a majority stake in Techforge Co., Ltd, holding company of AI-native micro-serial platform Anamana. Upon closing, expected November 2026 subject to customary conditions, Gamehaus expects to hold approximately 56% of Techforge; no price, per-share value, premium, or advisor is disclosed. The letter frames Anamana as the primary growth engine while the legacy gaming business is managed for cash flow; watch dilution, consideration structure, and closing mechanics.
